- Deliver a playable game now; do not ask clarifying questions.

- Implemented a browser-based arena game with fixed teams, AI-controlled allies and rivals, relic-control scoring, and keyboard, mouse, and touch controls.
- Assumed Athena is the player character; teams are Athena, Anansi, and Amaterasu versus Loki, Sekhmet, and Quetzal.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html` with the game UI, canvas-rendered arena, characters, combat, AI, respawning, relic scoring, timer, super ability, dash, and responsive mobile controls.

- Opened the game in Playwright, started a match, and inspected desktop and mobile JPEG screenshots.

- No active work.

- Browser check reported a missing `/favicon.ico` (404), an incidental console error; gameplay loaded and ran.

## Next Move
1. Optionally add a favicon or suppress the incidental 404.
2. Review `index.html` and make any desired gameplay or presentation refinements.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

- Changes are uncommitted.

- Screenshots were saved at `/tmp/opencode/mythic.jpg`, `/tmp/opencode/mythic-game.jpg`, and `/tmp/opencode/mythic-mobile.jpg`; the latest inspected screenshot was the mobile view.

content.text:
Built a playable 3v3 mythological arena game in `index.html`. Play as Athena with two AI allies against Loki, Sekhmet, and Quetzal; fight for relic control using movement, attacks, dash, and super abilities. Keyboard, mouse, and touch controls are supported.

Verified JavaScript syntax and checked desktop and mobile gameplay screenshots. Also added an inline favicon to eliminate the incidental 404. Assumption: matches use fixed teams and AI-controlled teammates and opponents.
